title: Smart escalation card and playbook KV index for low-latency on-call lookups
author: Lina Gomez
description: Motivation and summary: On largerincidents the on-call UI was repeatedly doing multi-step DB queries to assemble escalation cards (team membership, current rota, playbook pointer, recent runbook snapshots). That work was a measurable contributor to pager-attention latency spikes and flapping UI components reported by SRE. This PR adds a lightweight, cacheable KV index alongside the existing playbook store that pre-joins the small, hot subset of playbook metadata we need for immediate escalation; it also introduces a 'smart escalation card' transformer in incident-bot that fetches from that index first, with a deterministic fallback to the canonical store if keys are missing. This reduces the 95th percentile card render time and removes a number of anti-patterns where the UI retried slow joins. What this PR does (high level): 1) Introduces a new playbook_kv_index service and schema migration that stores {playbook_id -> abbreviated metadata: title, severity_hint, primary_contact_ids, last_updated, compact_tokenized_triggers}. 2) Implements an index writer that runs as part of the existing playbook write path (sync+async write modes). 3) Adds a card rendering path in incident-bot that queries the KV index (read-through) and falls back to the canonical store on miss. 4) Adds telemetry: per-key hit/miss counters, miss latency histogram, and a small gauge for index staleness. 5) Adds an optional rollout flag and a two-step canary plan to limit impact. Checklist: - [x] Schema migration designed and backward compatible (no forced downtime). - [x] Writer uses best-effort async retry with backoff; synchronous write enabled behind feature flag for customers who require atomicity. - [x] Read path implements deterministic fallback when index miss or degraded. - [x] Telemetry and dashboards added (SLO-focused). - [x] Unit and integration tests included; e2e smoke test against local playbook store included. - [x] Documentation: README and rollout instructions added to docs/oncall/kv-index.md. Rollout plan: Stage 1 (canary) enable index reads for 5% of requests in staging and production; Stage 2 enable writes (async) for 100% while keeping fallback; Stage 3 enable sync writes behind customer opt-in. Monitoring and rollback: watch the new telemetry dashboards (index_hit_rate, index_miss_latency) and oncall-card-error-rate; rollback involves flipping the rollout flag which reverts reads to canonical store immediately. Backwards compatibility notes: index is purely additive; absence of a key triggers fallback. Database migration: a small table and an LRU cleanup TTL; migration has been performance-tested on a copy of the production sample. Links and references: Linear ENG-7482 tracks the index lifecycle; SUP-331 is a support ticket referencing customer-facing latency reports. For reviewers: look at writer durability trade-offs (sync vs async) and the telemetry labels used for downstream dashboards.
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial schema+migration + index writer + smart card read-path and telemetry. Commit 1: add migration and table definition with docs. Commit 2: implement playbook index writer and feature flags, tests for writer durability. Commit 3: integrate read-path into incident-bot card renderer, telemetry, and rollout config; update README and release notes.
review_conversation: Evan: Please add more unit tests around partial write failures; note about retry cost. Lina: Added tests and a retry budget limiter to avoid tight loops. Priya: Concern about schema growth and TTL semantics on high-cardinality playbooks. Lina: Added TTL config and background cleanup job with opt-out for flagged customers. Samir: Approve with nits on metric naming. Lina: Addressed nits and squashed commits. Final approval by Priya and Evan.
ci_checks: CI summary: initial run had 1 flaky integration failure (test_kv_index_end2end) which was due to test ordering; fixed by making the test idempotent and adding a small readiness wait. All unit tests now pass. Lint and typecheck clean. Security scan: no secrets; dependency audit: one dev-only lint bump. Flaky test rerun green.
release_notes: Added a playbook KV index to incident-bot to speed up on-call escalation card rendering. Default rollout is disabled; ops can enable via feature_flags. Contains telemetry for monitoring index health. Migration adds a small table and a TTL-based cleanup job. No user-facing breaking changes.
